sections.title: The -iendo Ending
sections.content:
For regular verbs ending in **-er** and **-ir**, form the gerund by dropping the infinitive ending and adding **-iendo**:
- comer → **comiendo** (eating)
- beber → **bebiendo** (drinking)
- escribir → **escribiendo** (writing)
- vivir → **viviendo** (living)

items.spanish: Estoy escribiendo un mensaje para Carlos.
items.english: I am writing a message for Carlos.
We are learning many new words.

items.spanish: Ellos están bebiendo té en la terraza.
items.english: They are drinking tea on the terrace.

sections.content: Both -er and -ir verbs share the exact same gerund suffix: **-iendo**.
